goal: Answer six common interview questions in a row, using what you practised on Days 1 to 6.

phrases.example: My name is Hina Raza and I am from Multan.
I have a degree in business studies.
One of my strengths is paying attention to details.

phrases.text: I am interested in this job because ...

meaning.roman: Mujhe yeh job is liye pasand hai ke ...

phrases.example: I am interested in this job because I like working with numbers.

task.roman: Salam karein aur apna taaruf karayein: naam aur shehr.

roleplay.model_answer: Good morning. My name is Hina Raza and I am from Multan. It is nice to meet you.

task.roman: Apni taleem ke baare mein batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I have a degree in business studies. I finished it last year at a university in Multan.

roleplay.tutor_line: What work or internship experience do you have?

task.roman: Apne tajurbe ya internship ke baare mein batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I did a three-month internship in an accounts office. My main responsibility was to enter invoices into the computer.

roleplay.tutor_line: What is one of your strengths?

task.roman: Apni ek khubi batayein aur misaal dein.

roleplay.model_answer: One of my strengths is paying attention to details. For example, I check my work twice before I submit it.

roleplay.tutor_line: What is one weakness, and how are you improving it?

task.roman: Apni ek kamzori aur uski behtari ke liye apni koshish batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: One thing I am working on is speaking in front of groups. To improve, I practise speaking English every day.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why are you interested in this job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap yeh job kyun karna chahte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I am interested in this job because I like working with numbers. I want to learn and grow in this field.

review_notes: This day assumes the learner has done Days 1 to 6. Should a learner be allowed to start here, or must they finish the earlier days first?
